title: Brand Guidelines Profile
description: The checkable parts of a brand's guidelines (brand/<name>.yaml), listed in the manifest's brandGuidelines. tools/brand_check.py, the post-edit hook and tools/screenshots.py warn when something meant to follow them doesn't match. Values come from the official guidelines, never from memory; an empty profile still warns whenever it's referenced.

source.description: The guidelines document this was filled from, with its date or version.

triggers.description: Words, alt text or aria-labels that mean something is meant to follow these guidelines. A page can also declare it: <meta name="brand-guidelines" content="<name>">.

nearMissDeltaE.description: A color within this CIE76 distance of a brand color, but not its exact value, is flagged. About 2 is barely visible; 10 is a clearly different shade.

strictPalette.description: Also flag any non-neutral color outside the palette.

typefaces.description: The families the guidelines allow. These are exempt from the generic-font warning.

nameForms.description: The allowed ways to write the name. Any other casing of a trigger word is flagged.

selector.description: CSS selector that finds this logo on a rendered page, e.g. [data-brand-asset='atari-fuji'].

aspectRatio.description: Width ÷ height. Null: compare with the image's own proportions.

minClearSpacePx.description: The smallest allowed gap between the logo and any other text, image or control.

clearSpaceRatio.description: The same, as a fraction of the logo's rendered height (0.25 = 25%).

allowedColors.description: The colors an inline SVG logo may be drawn in.

maxColors.description: How many colors one logo may use (1 = never two colors).

logo.description: One logo rule. For several kinds of logo, use logos.

never.description: Rules only a person can judge. The critic reads these.

transform.description: CSS text-transform, e.g. 'uppercase'. Text already typed in capitals counts.
